# C&T Consulting Engineers

> C&T Consulting Engineers is a multidisciplinary engineering practice founded in 2011, delivering MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) design, BIM modelling and CFD analysis for buildings, airports, data centres, industrial facilities and oil & gas projects worldwide. Headquartered in Trivandrum, Kerala, India, with offices in the UAE and Canada, and project delivery across India, the Middle East, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Canada and Europe.

C&T operates through two divisions with dedicated teams:
- **Buildings & Infrastructure** — architectural, structural and MEP engineering design, BIM coordination (up to LOD 400) and drafting for buildings, airports, data centres and infrastructure.
- **Oil & Gas** — detailed engineering and high-LOD (up to LOD 500) 3D modelling for refineries, LNG plants and offshore platforms.

Core services: MEP engineering design, BIM & 3D modelling, clash detection & coordination, CFD & FEA analysis, hydraulic calculations, ETAP power-system studies, tendering & MTO, cOBie asset management, peer review consultation, and engineering resource deployment. Work is backed by an ISO 9001:2015 certified quality system.
